note: Plan-segments carriers pay NO commission on for 2027 effective dates, in the 18 licensed states. seg 0 = all segments. counties null = all counties in the state. Applied by scripts/commission/apply-noncommissionable.js (hide from agents, Dale 2026-10-15).

sources.Humana: 2027 Individual Products Producer Partnership Plan, GHHN7GKEN 01/2027 A, "Non-Commissionable Counties for Specified Medicare Products" pp.19-27 (assets.humana.com, via Vantage > Commissions), read 2026-10-15
sources.HealthSpring: "2027 Non-commissionable, Partially Commissionable and Suppressed Plans" job aid (university.healthspringforbrokers.com, Products > Benefit Information - 2027, PDF 12853 dated 2026-10-14), read 2026-10-15. Non-commissionable AND suppressed plans are both removed from broker enrollment platforms -> hidden. Partially commissionable (75% FMV) stays visible, listed under partialCommission.
sources.Aetna Medicare: "Non-Commissionable Individual Medicare Products - Plan Year 2027" (PY2027 National Non-Commissionable List, Aetna, last updated 8/20/2026, 19 pp.; Dale supplied 2026-10-15). Entries transcribed from the page images for the 18 licensed states; every county list checked equals the plan's full 2027 service area in that state, so entries are whole-state (counties null). PDP (S5601) entries ignored - no PDPs in Plan Finder. Note H1608-16/-18 are listed under "KS, MO" with counties in both states.
sources.UnitedHealthcare: Jarvis (checked 2026-10-15): the only published UHC non-commissionable list is the Southern California "Commissionable Plans" page (outside the footprint); the EDC Agent Guide 10-01-2026 and the 2027 MA Plans QRG name no plans. Two FL Regional PPOs are carrier-stated "NO commission for 1/1/2027+ effectives" per the UHC FL 2027 Carrier Commission Notes captured in 2027_MAPD_Plan_Exits_AL_MS_FL (No-Commission Plans tab, 2026-09-30/10-02): R0759-1 (AARP MA from UHC FL-0031) and R0759-2 (AARP MA Patriot No Rx FL-MA01). Closed-to-new-members UHC D-SNPs were already removed from 2027 rows (remove-closed-uhc-2027.js). "Non-promoted / not featured" UHC plans are still commissionable and stay visible.

notHidden.nonPromoted: Plans carriers do not feature on agent portals / Sunfire / Connecture (Devoted AL list, Humana "Legacy" list, UHC "not featured", Wellcare MS "suppressed in broker materials") are enrollable and not known to be non-commissionable; they stay visible. See 2027_MAPD_Plan_Exits_AL_MS_FL-Escambia-SantaRosa_2.xlsx > No-Commission Plans tab.
